decisions.reason: As an outpatient sociotherapy service close to the core care portfolio and elevated from a website mention to the home page, it carries growing public commitment and fit, so management is likely to continue it unless results clearly deteriorate.

Because this counseling service for senior living has been on the home page in both years and aligns tightly with the firm's established eldercare activities, management has strong incentives to justify and maintain the launch.
The retail shop builds on the sheltered workshop offer and gained stronger visibility in 2024, so sunk effort, mission fit, and public commitment make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Although meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's service logic, it is newer and only lightly publicized so far, so it is easier to discontinue than the older, more visibly backed launches if performance disappoints.
